title: Deploy EntraPolicySuite's external alarm in Azure Monitor
purpose: Creates or updates an Azure Monitor rule set that alerts independently of the product: missing log data, Conditional Access policy changes, break-glass account sign-ins and actions in Entra and AD, a watched tag changed by a foreign writer, and the product's heartbeat stopping. Built from the product's settings each time it runs.
whenToRun: After the install, and again after a break-glass account, a tag type, the tamper allow list or the recipients change.

runAs.name: Contributor (Monitoring Contributor is enough for the rules and the action group)
runAs.why: creates the action group and the scheduled query rules

runAs.name: Security Administrator or Global Administrator
runAs.why: creates the Entra diagnostic setting that sends AuditLogs and the sign-in logs to Log Analytics (only if none does yet)

runAs.name: the EntraPolicySuite SQL server's Entra admin
runAs.why: reads the break-glass accounts, the tag types and the allow list

changes.object: diagnostic setting eps-entra-logs (AuditLogs, SignInLogs, NonInteractiveUserSignInLogs -> the install's Log Analytics workspace), unless one already sends AuditLogs
eps-* rules no longer wanted (e.g. the AD rules when no AD break-glass account remains)
changes.why: the rules follow exactly the accounts in the module
changes.undo: run again after adding the account back

parameters.name: SubscriptionId
parameters.help: the subscription EntraPolicySuite is installed in

readsOnly: the product's break-glass accounts, tag types and tamper allow list (SQL)
whatIf: Every resource it would create, update or remove; nothing is changed.
undo: Delete ag-eps-alarm and the eps-* rules; delete the diagnostic setting eps-entra-logs if it was created by this script.
